links.note: A leaking water pipe noticed on the way to school - this concept's own example of a citizen duty is that if people notice a water leakage in a street, reporting it promptly will prevent further wastage of precious water.

Why urban governance is more complex - this concept states it, that since the urban scenario is generally more complex and diverse than the rural one, the urban governance system needs to be more complex too.

Indore's seven consecutive Swachh Survekshan awards and the THINK ABOUT IT asking what the role of its citizens could have been - this concept's point that seven years in a row cannot be the work of a department alone, which is why the assertion is false. Already linked and correct.

The idea behind local bodies being decentralisation - this concept explains that instead of operating under a central authority, local communities have a direct say in how their areas are managed. Already linked and correct.
Why an urban governance system is more complex than a rural one - this concept's closing sentence gives the reason, the greater complexity and diversity of the urban scenario.
Ward committees facilitating health camps and campaigns against single-use plastics, and reporting water leaks, blocked drains and damaged roads - this concept's two kinds of ward work.
Three functions of urban local bodies - this concept's list runs from infrastructure and burial grounds through garbage collection to local taxes and fines. Already linked and correct.
How responsible citizens help, with waste segregation and reporting a water leak as the examples - this concept's own pair. Already linked and correct.
Local government structures in urban areas called urban local bodies - this concept's opening sentence.
Decentralised explained as local communities having a direct say in how their areas are managed rather than operating under a central authority - this concept's gloss. Already linked and correct.
Cities and towns divided into smaller units called wards - this concept's sentence.
Ward committees conducting health camps and organising a campaign against single-use plastics - this concept's two examples.
A water leak, a blocked drain, a damaged road - this concept's list of the things ward committees watch for and report to the authorities.
The Madras Corporation established on 29 September 1688, the oldest municipal institution in India - this concept's opening.
The East India Company issuing the charter that constituted Fort St. George and the territories within 46 km into a Corporation - this concept's account.
The Parliamentary Act of 1792 giving the Madras Corporation power to levy municipal taxes - this concept's date, and the point at which it says municipal administration properly began.
Indore in Madhya Pradesh awarded the cleanest city in India under Swachh Survekshan for seven years in a row - this concept's THINK ABOUT IT.
Anita visiting her grandparents from the city, and Sameer living in the village - this concept's dialogue. Already linked and correct.
Sameer saying it sounds like their village Panchayat, only bigger - this concept's line. Already linked and correct.
Why the urban governance system needs to be more complex - this concept's own reasoning about the greater complexity and diversity of the urban scenario.

Elaborating on the specific complexities of a city is this concept's LET'S EXPLORE, which asks why a city like Kolkata, Chennai or Mumbai is more complex and diverse than a village or town and has the class list the diverse communities living there.
Comparing the base of the pyramid for rural and urban areas - this concept is the pyramid diagram, with chapter 11 on its left side and this chapter on its right. Already linked and correct.
The sentence quoted in the stem is this concept's own - for these bodies to perform their functions efficiently, people living in the city must also perform their duties. Already linked and correct.
Sameer's remark that sometimes even the children get heard, and Anita's surprise at it - this concept's dialogue. Already linked and correct.
People of the Ward at the base of the pyramid - this concept describes the diagram, whose base is the local level closest to the people. Already linked and correct.

The question actually answered here is the Madras Corporation's evolution from a company charter to a body empowered by a Parliamentary Act to levy taxes, which is this concept's material and its point that the power to raise its own money is what makes a local body a government. Note: this item's stem is a Municipal Council property-tax case spliced onto that question's tail.
The dialogue's picture of rural cohesion against urban anonymity, and Anita's correction that there is still community in the city - this concept's exchange. Already linked and correct.

The sentence quoted in the stem is this concept's - the citizens also have duties to ensure that the local bodies are able to perform their functions efficiently - which the chapter names as participatory democracy. Already linked and correct.
Sameer saying even the children get heard and Anita finding it surprising - this concept's contrast, where each child corrects the other's assumption. Already linked and correct.

How decentralisation empowers local communities - this concept defines it as a mechanism for citizens living in an area to come together and take decisions about what is best for them. Already linked and correct.
